_comment: Copy to tools/roi.json and tune with `node tools/inspect.mjs <capture>`. All rects are [x, y, w, h] as FRACTIONS of the frame (same convention as the app's map coords), so 720p and 1080p captures both work. The values below are rough guesses for NSS golf's HUD layout — they WILL need adjusting against a real capture.

gauge._comment: Power meter. axis y + fillFrom bottom = vertical bar filling upward.

distance._comment: Distance-to-pin HUD number (yards). polarity light = bright digits on dark.

windArrow._comment: Arrow glyph box. Direction read is not implemented yet; learn 8 rotated templates once captures exist.
